text: I feel a quiet sense of anticipation wandering through this space—a place where ideas seem to be fostered and put on display. The modern glass meeting room feels clinical, almost sterile, yet inviting in its promise of collaboration. Moving to the vivid R+D exhibit, I am energized by the celebration of innovative thought, but also feel the weight of the question: where do I fit in the rapid evolution of technology and research? It is a humbling and inspiring atmosphere, one that encourages contemplation of my own capacity for curiosity and creation.
